summary: Iteration 8 — End-to-end verification of multi-file customs flow (airway-bill + customs-document) and admin-only INTERNAL NOTES. BACKEND (20/20 pytest pass, /app/backend/tests/test_customs_multifile.py): GET /api/orders/{id}/customs returns the customs blob with airway_bill_files[] + customs_files[] + airway_bill_text + notes for admin AND owning manufacturer; returns 403 for manufacturer on a foreign order, and 403 for associate + client. PUT /api/orders/{id}/customs honours role gating: admin can write notes + airway_bill_text (persisted, verified via GET); manufacturer can write airway_bill_text but a manufacturer-supplied 'notes' field is correctly IGNORED (the admin-set canonical note is preserved on the server). Manufacturer PUT on a foreign order = 403; associate + client = 403. POST /api/orders/{id}/customs/files/{kind} happy paths for admin (airway-bill) and manufacturer (customs) both 200 and persist the entry with id + uploaded_by + uploaded_by_email; foreign-order POST as mfg = 403; associate + client POST = 403; unknown 'kind' path param = 400. DELETE /api/orders/{id}/customs/files/{kind}/{file_id}: admin can delete any file (verified the airway-bill entry disappears from the array post-delete); manufacturer cannot delete an admin-uploaded file (403); manufacturer can delete a file they themselves uploaded (verified array shrink). DELETE with unknown 'kind' = 400. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): ADMIN (admin@somnio.co) — /(app)/customs/{orderId} renders AIRWAY BILL + CUSTOMS DOCUMENT sections with UPLOAD buttons + empty-state copy + airway-bill text input + INTERNAL NOTES (ADMIN-ONLY) textarea + SAVE TEXT FIELDS button. SAVE persists airway_bill_text + notes via PUT /customs (HTTP 200). MANUFACTURER (mfg@somnio.co) — CUSTOMS button is visible on the order detail screen for their own orders; tapping navigates to the customs screen. The airway-bill section + airway-bill text input + customs-document section render. The INTERNAL NOTES textarea is NOT in the DOM (data-testid='customs-notes-input' count=0) — confirming admin-only gating. SAVE TEXT FIELDS posts a PUT /customs (HTTP 200). ASSOCIATE (associate@somnio.co) — CUSTOMS button is absent from the order detail screen (testID count=0); manual navigation to /(app)/customs/{orderId} correctly bounces the user back to '/' (the role-bouncer useEffect on the customs screen redirects via router.replace('/(app)')). CLIENT (client@somnio.co) — identical behaviour: no CUSTOMS button on order detail, manual nav to /customs/{orderId} redirects out.

react_native_issues.component: customs/[orderId].tsx (or one of its render paths)
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning observed once during associate flow: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — likely a stray whitespace literal inside a parent <View>. Cosmetic only; no visual breakage. Reference: customs screen render path. Worth a grep for stray ' ' / '\n' between JSX siblings.
Recurring console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — same as previously noted; cosmetic, not user-facing.

action_items: No blocking action items. Multi-file customs flow is fully functional end-to-end across all four roles.
OPTIONAL (P3, cosmetic): grep customs/[orderId].tsx for stray whitespace/newlines between JSX siblings inside a <View> to silence the 'Unexpected text node' warning. Does not affect functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders.py:584-622 (PUT /customs): manufacturer branch correctly assigns only airway_bill_text to the customs sub-doc and leaves admin-owned fields (notes, airway_bill, customs_document) untouched — a manufacturer cannot smuggle in 'notes' via the PUT body. Clean implementation.

routes/orders.py:664-712 (POST /customs/files/{kind}): stores uploaded_by + uploaded_by_email + uploaded_at_china + resource_type defaulting to 'raw'; records an order.customs.<kind>.added activity event. Good audit trail.

routes/orders.py:715-763 (DELETE): the manufacturer-ownership check uses uploaded_by == user['id'] which is exactly the spec ('manufacturer can only remove files they themselves uploaded'). 404 surfaces correctly when the file_id is unknown, before the ownership check, which is the right precedence.
customs/[orderId].tsx:68-72: role bouncer redirects any non-admin / non-manufacturer user to /(app). Verified end-to-end with associate + client logins.
customs/[orderId].tsx:305-318: INTERNAL NOTES textarea is wrapped in `user?.role === 'admin' && (...)` and not rendered for manufacturer — verified via Playwright data-testid count=0.

FileList component (customs/[orderId].tsx:380-450): trash icon visibility is `isAdmin || file.uploaded_by === currentUserId` which mirrors backend permissions. Defence-in-depth — the backend will still 403 a manufacturer trying to delete an admin file, but the UI also hides the button.
cloudinaryUpload.ts:207-241 (uploadCustomsFile): uses signed upload with resource_type='raw' to the somnio/customs folder — same shape as uploadCadFile, consistent.

Backend tests upload test files prefixed with TEST_ and clean themselves up by exercising the DELETE path. No persistent test residue beyond text fields ('TEST_admin_notes_xxxxxx' on the order's customs.notes) — admin-only field, does not bleed to other roles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The customs URL on Expo Router is /(app)/customs/{orderId}. On web preview, parentheses in the route segment are part of the file-system route group convention — direct URL navigation works (verified). The role bouncer is a useEffect inside CustomsScreen that calls router.replace('/(app)') for any role other than admin + manufacturer; on web this lands the user on '/' (the index of (app)). data-testIDs available on the customs screen: 'customs-close', 'airway-upload-button', 'customs-upload-button', 'airway-text-input', 'customs-notes-input' (admin only), 'customs-save-button', 'customs-row-<file_id>', 'customs-open-<file_id>', 'customs-delete-<file_id>'. The notify('Saved') toast on save uses window.alert on web (src/utils/confirm.ts:46-54) — Playwright auto-dismisses alert dialogs so don't assert 'text=Saved' in the DOM; instead listen for page.on('dialog') or just trust the PUT 200 response. Backend test_customs_multifile.py module-scopes the tokens + mfg_order fixtures so it's fast (~4.5s for 20 tests).
